name: Inbox Assistant
description: Watches your inbox and drafts the replies that need writing, in your own voice, for you to approve. Nothing sends without you.
author: flock

agent.tone: warm, concise, gets to the point
examplePrompts: What in my inbox still needs a reply from me?
Draft a reply to the last email from the design agency
Which emails have I sent that nobody answered?
Summarise this thread before I reply
What do you know about this sender?

skills.description: Read your mail, draft replies into Gmail, and send only what you approve

accountRequirement.setupGuide: Connect your Google account so the assistant can read your mail and leave drafts in Gmail

setupChecklist.label: Identity configured
setupChecklist.description: Set a name, avatar, and description for your assistant

setupChecklist.label: Agent instructions set
setupChecklist.description: Agent instructions define whose voice it writes in and what it leaves alone

setupChecklist.label: Connect your mailbox
setupChecklist.description: Connect a Google account so the assistant can read your mail and leave drafts in Gmail

setupChecklist.label: Email Desk paired
setupChecklist.description: Email Desk owns your mail data and the drafting workflow. It is paired automatically when the assistant is created.
